title: Positive Duration Excludes the Entry State
statement: Let $C$ be a contract with entry state $e$ and exit set $X$. If every admissible start configuration in state $e$ has strictly positive assigned running time, then the optional state $\\mathrm{some}(e)$ does not belong to $X$.
hypotheses_covered: $C$ is a contract with entry state $e$ and exit set $X$
For every data value and configuration in state $e$ satisfying the precondition, the assigned running time is strictly positive
replaced:
Let $C$ be a contract with entry state $\mathrm{entry}$. If every admissible start
configuration in that state has strictly positive contract time, then
$\mathrm{some}(\mathrm{entry})$ does not belong to the contract’s exit set.
